Zane Park: Hi everyone  Zane here, joining as Reliability Engineer. First day! Quick Qs: who do I ping for VPN + repo access? Also my laptop says "out for delivery" but no ETA. Any rec for nearby lunch spots for onboarding lunch? :pizza:
Rina Shah: welcome Zane!! for access ping #eng-infra and drop your public ssh key if you want pre-authorized. Laptop ETA usually updates by courier around midday, but DM me the tracking and Ill check. For lunch, the cafe downstairs does great bowls and we usually do a signup in #general.
Zane Park: thanks Rina. dropping pubkey here to speed infra up:
ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQDfakekeyzane zane@home
Liam O'Connor: hey Zane  Liam from infra. Got your key, well attach it and start VPN onboarding. If you run into 403s after SSO, ping me and Ill traceroute permissions. Preferred OS?
Zane Park: macOS please. Also curious about badge pickup and whether facilities drops a desk plant by default? :seedling:
FacilitiesBot: Welcome Zane Park. Badge pickup: reception after 10:30 under your full name. Plant requests are optional; reply "plant: yes" to include a small ZZ plant. Desk location: 3C-07 (3rd floor, center pod). Reply "desk: standing" to request a converter.
Zane Park: plant: yes. desk: standing please. Appreciate it!
Rina Shah: FYI 12pm team lunch in the kitchen island, swing by if you can. Also adding you to the team calendar and Figma once IT confirms SSO.
Zane Park: fun fact to introduce: I brew my own kombucha and once raced a soapbox car. Two truths & a lie?
Liam O'Connor: kombucha true, soapbox true, hmm maybe you didn't race it?
Zane Park: reveal: both true, lie = I have been skydiving (havent yet!). Thanks for the warm welcome everyone. Ill follow up in #eng-infra if any permission hiccups.
OnboarderBot: Welcome Zane Park. New hire checklist started. IT ticket IT-5022 opened for asset tracking. Reminder: security training due by day 5.
